claims.sourceText: Jacques Vallee, Forbidden Science (1992) and subsequent correspondence quoted by CUFON
claims.text: Vallee holds that the Robertson Panel, which met 14-16 January 1953, was not briefed on the Pentacle proposals, and that a separate group had already determined the boundaries of what the panel could discuss.

topics.title: The Battelle nitinol allegation and the Naval Ordnance Laboratory record
